question:
The following graph shows the number of cars of different colours in a society.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4c62291526cda2bd18e05c9bf3dc08102c6ab1c6ff8020cb8272148c6c06fb75.png] 

What is the approximate percentage of white colour cars out of all cars in the society?
solution:
**Calculation:**

Total number of cars in the society = 15 + 25 + 5 + 20 + 10 = 75

Number of white cars = 25

Percentage of white colour cars out of all cars in the society = 25/75 × 100

⇒ 33.33%

**∴ Option 2 is the correct answer.**
